import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Revenue by product (top 10)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars1 = ax1.barh(range(len(product_revenue)), product_revenue.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(product_revenue)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(product_revenue.index)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Products by Revenue', fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(product_revenue.values):
    ax1.text(v + max(product_revenue.values)*0.01, i, f'${v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales distribution by time of day
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax2.bar(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, color='saddlebrown', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax2.set_title('Revenue by Hour of Day', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Revenue by customer age group
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_revenue = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
bars3 = ax3.bar(age_revenue.index, age_revenue.values, color=['#8B4513', '#A0522D', '#D2691E', '#CD853F', '#F4A460'])
ax3.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group')
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax3.set_title('Revenue by Customer Age Group', fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(age_revenue.values):
    ax3.text(i, v + max(age_revenue.values)*0.01, f'${v:,.0f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in revenue
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
takeaway_revenue = df.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(takeaway_revenue.values, labels=takeaway_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                    colors=['#DEB887', '#8B4513'], startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Revenue: Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 5. Payment method distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
bars5 = ax5.bar(payment_counts.index, payment_counts.values, color=['#2E8B57', '#3CB371', '#66CDAA'])
ax5.set_xlabel('Payment Method')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax5.set_title('Transaction Count by Payment Method', fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(payment_counts.values):
    ax5.text(i, v + max(payment_counts.values)*0.01, f'{v:,}', ha='center', fontsize=9)

# 6. Average transaction value by size
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_avg = df.groupby('size')['total'].mean().reindex(size_order)
bars6 = ax6.bar(size_avg.index, size_avg.values, color=['#FFD700', '#CD853F', '#8B4513'])
ax6.set_xlabel('Product Size')
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)')
ax6.set_title('Average Revenue by Product Size', fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(size_avg.values):
    ax6.text(i, v + max(size_avg.values)*0.01, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', fontsize=9)

plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
